scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hm...?
Ah, I sense that you are a warrior that has been to Valhalla. You who have been reborn... We are here to look after you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
嗯...？
啊，我感觉到你是一位去过瓦尔哈拉的战斗者。重生后的你...我们在这里守护着你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Do not let evil conquer your soul. You have enough courage and power to overcome the hardest situation. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
不要让邪恶征服你的灵魂。你有足够的勇气和力量去克服最艰难的局面。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah...
It is good to see you again, Brother {0}. Once again, God's grace has caused our paths to cross.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
啊...
很高兴再次见到你，{0}兄弟。上帝的恩典再次让我们的道路交汇。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah...
It is good to see you once again, Sister {0}. The grace of God has brought you once more before me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
啊...
很高兴再次见到你，{0}姐妹。上帝的恩典再次将你带到我的面前。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I'm pleased to see that you are continuing to lead the children of God on the right path. Is there anything I can help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很高兴看到你在继续引导上帝的子民走上正途。今天有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: How is your health?
scripts.translation: 您的身体还好吗？

scripts.text: I want to help this Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 我想帮助这位服事。

scripts.text: Father, I need your help.
scripts.translation: 神父，我需要您的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Thank you for your concern. I'm doing fine and am in good health. Please give my regards to your brothers and sisters.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
谢谢你的关心。我很好，身体健康。请代我向你的兄弟姐妹们问好。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Keep in mind that we are God's messengers on this Earth. Always remember that we must always help others.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请记住，我们是上帝在地球上的使者。永远记住，我们必须始终帮助他人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah, that's a good idea. Helping young Acolytes should also be one of a Priest's priorities.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
啊，这是个好主意。帮助年轻的服事也应该是牧师的首要任务之一。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
However, there are certain things that an Acolyte must do alone. All Acolytes must complete their divine test by themselves.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
不过，有些事情服事必须独自完成。所有服事都必须独自完成神圣的考验。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will assist your Acolyte friend in the second test, the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我希望你能协助你的服事朋友完成第二项考验，即灵性训练。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You need to bring ^0000FF1 Rosary^000000 in order to accompany an Acolyte in spiritual training. If you have one of those, I can send you to the test area now.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你需要携带^0000FF1个念珠^000000才能陪同服事进行灵性训练。如果你有的话，我现在就可以送你到考验区域。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Do you wish to help him out during the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你愿意在灵性训练中帮助他吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I will now send you to the training place for Acolytes. Please send my regards to Brother Peter...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我现在就送你到服事的训练地点。请代我向彼得兄弟问好...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will assist this Acolyte in becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我希望你能协助这位服事成为牧师。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Unfortunately you didn't bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000. You need one of those in order to be in the testing area.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
不幸的是，你没有带^0000FF念珠^000000。你需要一个才能进入考验区域。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see, take your time. Don't forget to bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
明白了，请慢慢来。别忘了带^0000FF念珠^000000...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You must be strong. Have faith, as you are loved by God. I pray the wounds of the body are healed soon...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你必须要坚强。要有信仰，因为上帝爱你。我祈祷你身上的伤痛能早日康复...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, please look after your poor children. Help them overcome their hardships and difficulties. Refresh their spirits...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
上帝啊，请眷顾您可怜的子民。帮助他们克服艰难困苦，恢复他们的精神...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope my invocation has eased your pain. Now please go forth and spread God's message. May God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
希望我的祈祷能减轻你的痛苦。现在请去吧，传播上帝的旨意。愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝与你同在，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝与你同在，姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You are in
the Sanctuary.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你身处圣堂之中。
是什么风把你吹来的？

scripts.text: I want to be an Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 我想成为服事。

scripts.text: I want to be a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成为牧师。

scripts.text: Nothing, really.
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Oh I see...
If you wish to become an Acolyte, please visit the other room.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
原来如此...
如果你想成为服事，请去隔壁的房间。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Oh I see. However, you must first become an Acolyte before becoming a Priest. Please visit the other room.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
原来如此。不过，你必须先成为服事，才能成为牧师。请去隔壁的房间。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please make yourself at home. On Earth, nowhere is safer than this Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请自便。在世间，没有比这座圣堂更安全的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝与你同在，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝与你同在，姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
What brings you here
to Prontera Sanctuary?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
是什么风把你吹到普隆德拉圣堂的？

scripts.text: Information about Priests.
scripts.translation: 关于牧师的信息。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Priests have the authority to perform and administer religious rites.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
牧师拥有主持和管理宗教仪式的权力。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You must first be thoroughly disciplined as an Acolyte before you can be promoted to the position of Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
在晋升为牧师之前，你必须先作为服事接受严格的训练。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you reach Acolyte Job level 40, you will be able to apply for the Priest test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
当你的服事职业等级达到40级时，你就可以参加牧师的考核了。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you pass the test, you will be able to use more powerful skills that will be effective against Demon and Undead creatures...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
如果你通过了考核，就能使用更强大的技能，这些技能对恶魔和亡灵生物非常有效...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
With all of your ability, you will play an important role in towns and dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
凭借你的能力，你将在城镇和迷宫中发挥重要的作用。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Our duty and obligation as Priests is to devote ourselves to helping others without expecting reward.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
作为牧师，我们的职责和义务是无私奉献，帮助他人，而不求任何回报。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
As we help others, we must not expect to treat us in a similar fashion. To be a great Priest is your choice and responsibility, not anyone else's.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
在帮助他人的同时，我们不应期待他人以同样的方式对待我们。成为一名伟大的牧师是你的选择和责任，而不是任何人的。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
However, those who receive should be polite. You should give an outstanding example, but you should also have your limits as a human.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
然而，接受帮助的人应当保持礼貌。你应该树立卓越的榜样，但作为凡人，你也有自己的极限。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope I explained enough of the class. Why don't you go outside and talk to some of the other Priests if you want to learn more about our way of life?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我想我已经把这个职业解释得够清楚了。如果你想更多地了解我们的生活方式，不妨到外面去和其他牧师聊聊？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please make yourself at home. Nowhere on Earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请自便。普隆德拉圣堂是世上最安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well...
May God
bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么...
愿上帝保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless
you, Brother.
What brings
you to me?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝保佑你，兄弟。
有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless
you, Sister.
What brings
you to me?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿上帝保佑你，姐妹。
有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成为牧师。

scripts.text: How are you, Father?
scripts.translation: 神父，您好。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see. So you wish to be a Priest. God will be delighted by your decision and will bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我明白了。所以你想成为一名牧师。上帝会因你的决定而喜悦，并赐福于你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I am Bishop Paul Cervantes, and am in charge of the Prontera Parish.
I am glad to meet a person as eager and devoted to God such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我是保罗·塞万提斯主教，负责普隆德拉教区。
很高兴能遇到像你这样对上帝如此热切和虔诚的人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you set your mind on becoming a Priest, you must undergo several tests. Only Acolytes who reach job level 40 are qualified for testing.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
如果你下定决心要成为牧师，就必须通过几项测试。只有职业等级达到40级的服事才有资格参加测试。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you satisfy the requirements, I suggest that you apply for the Priest job first. Do you wish to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
如果你满足条件，我建议你先申请牧师职业。你现在要申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: I need some time to think about it...
scripts.translation: 我需要时间考虑一下...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You are not yet qualified to be a Priest. Please go out into the world and broaden your experiences.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你还不符合成为牧师的条件。请去外面的世界历练，丰富你的阅历吧。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
There are still things that you must learn as an Acolyte. However, I look forward to meeting you again very soon.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
作为服事，你还有很多东西要学。不过，我期待很快能再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You have skill points left.
I strongly recommend that you use all of these skill points before you apply for the Priest job change test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你还有剩余的技能点。
我强烈建议你在申请牧师转职测试之前，把这些技能点全部用完。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Brother {0}.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
现在我要向你解释牧师的三重试炼。这些磨难会给你带来巨大的痛苦，但我希望你能完成它们，{0}兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Sister {0}.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
现在我要向你解释牧师的三重试炼。这些磨难会给你带来巨大的痛苦，但我希望你能完成它们，{0}姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
For the First Trial, you will make a pilgrimage, and visit three acscetic Priests in a specific order.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
第一重试炼，你需要进行朝圣，并按特定顺序拜访三位苦行僧牧师。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
The Second Trial will consist of spiritual training. You must resist the temptations of Demons and the Undead.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
第二重试炼是精神训练。你必须抵抗恶魔和亡者的诱惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
In the Final Trial, you will promise your devotion to God. Your willingness to sacrifice yourself will also be questioned.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
在最终试炼中，你将向神宣誓效忠。你自我牺牲的意愿也将受到考验。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Acolytes that have reached Job Level 50 will be exempt from the First Trial, the pilgrimage, as they have already demonstrated their enthusiasm and devotion.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
职业等级达到50级的服事可以免除第一重试炼，即朝圣，因为他们已经证明了他们的热情与虔诚。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I can see the great effort you have exerted to reach job level 50. You have been a loyal servant to God.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我能看出你为了达到职业等级50付出了巨大的努力。你一直是神忠诚的仆人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now, you may go directly go to the Second Trial: Spiritual Training. For this training, you may bring a Priest with you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
现在，你可以直接进行第二重试炼：精神训练。在这次训练中，你可以带一名牧师同行。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I have no doubt that you will do a good job by yourself. However, it will be easier with the aid of a Brother or Sister that has already become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我毫不怀疑你能独自完成得很好。不过，如果有已经转职为牧师的兄弟或姐妹协助，会更容易一些。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, are you ready for the Spiritual Training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么，你准备好进行精神训练了吗？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了。

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很好。我会送你去训练场。到达那里后，请去对话负责训练的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem, take your time.
May God give you the strength to overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
没问题，慢慢来。
愿神赐予你克服恐惧的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, let me tell you the order of the ascetic Priests that you must visit for your pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
好吧，让我告诉你朝圣时需要拜访的苦行僧牧师的顺序。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
First, please visit Father
Rubalkabara who is Northeast
of the Prontera Ruins.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
首先，请拜访位于普隆德拉废墟东北方的鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Second, please visit Sister Mathilda. She is located in
an area near Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
其次，请拜访玛蒂尔达修女。她位于普隆德拉西南方，摩洛哥附近的一个区域。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
The third Priest you must visit is Father Yosuke. He is in a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
第三位需要拜访的牧师是阳介神父。他在普隆德拉西北方的一片田野里。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I wish you a safe journey. If you have any questions, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么，祝你旅途平安。如果有任何问题，请询问塞西莉亚修女。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you return from your pilgrimage, I will let you know
of the next test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
当你从朝圣归来时，我会告诉你下一项测试的内容。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God
bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿神
保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please take your time.
You are always welcomed.
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请慢慢来。
你随时都受欢迎。
愿神保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see...
I am doing fine
and am in good health.
Thank you for asking.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我知道了...
我很好，
身体也很健康。
谢谢你的关心。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我希望你能继续作为神的仆人，履行你的使命，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我希望你能继续作为神的仆人，履行你的使命，姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hopefully, our paths
will cross again.
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
希望我们还能再次相遇。
愿神保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May I ask you the reason you're still here? You didn't forget your pilgrimage, did you?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请问你为什么还在这里？你没有忘记你的朝圣之旅吧？

scripts.text: Sorry father, I need to check the order.
scripts.translation: 抱歉神父，我需要确认一下顺序。

scripts.text: No no no, not at all.
scripts.translation: 不不不，完全没有。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah, I see. I will let you know the order of pilgrimage again, and hope that you will have a safe journey.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
啊，我明白了。我会再次告诉你朝圣的顺序，并祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
First, meet Father Rubalkabara. He's at the Northeast of the Prontera ruins.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
首先，去见鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父。他在普隆德拉遗迹的东北方。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Then, remember to meet Sister Mathilda. She's somewhere near the town of Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
然后，记得去见玛蒂尔达修女。她在普隆德拉西南方的摩罗克镇附近。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
And lastly, please seek out Father Yosuke. He is in the a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
最后，请去寻找阳介神父。他在普隆德拉西北方的一片田野里。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. If you want more information, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么，我会为你祈祷旅途平安。如果你需要更多信息，请去问塞西莉亚修女。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you get back from the pilgrimage, I will let you know the next test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
当你从朝圣归来时，我会告诉你下一项测试的内容。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
愿神保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see. But still, if you have any questions, you may wish to ask Sister Cecilia. She will address any of your concerns.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
我明白了。不过，如果你有任何问题，不妨去问问塞西莉亚修女。她会解答你的疑惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么，我会为你祈祷旅途平安。愿神保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see you have returned from your meeting with Father Rubalkabara. How is he doing? I am worried about his health, since he's been there all alone...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
看来你已经从与鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父的会面中回来了。他怎么样？我很担心他的健康，因为他一直独自待在那里...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
For your next quest, you should meet Sister Mathilda. I shall be awaiting your safe return.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
对于你的下一个任务，你应该去见玛蒂尔达修女。我会等待你平安归来。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see that you have returned from your journey to meet Sister Mathilda. She has been meditating in the hot, dry desert for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
看来你已经完成了与玛蒂尔达修女的会面。她已经在炎热干燥的沙漠中冥想很久了。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Finally, it is now time for you to meet Father Yosuke. He is doing penance somewhere around a field Northwest of Prontera. Please seek him out, and then return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
最后，是时候去见阳介神父了。他正在普隆德拉西北方的一片田野附近进行忏悔。请找到他，然后回来见我。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You've accomplished
your pilgrimage.
Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你完成了你的朝圣之旅。
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now it is time to begin your spiritual training. As I mentioned before, you may bring a Priest to help you during this training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
现在是开始你灵性训练的时候了。正如我之前提到的，你可以带一名牧师来协助你进行这项训练。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Although you cannot receive their help throughout all of the testing, they can at least help you during the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
虽然他们无法在整个考验过程中都帮助你，但至少可以在灵性训练期间协助你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, are you ready for
the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么，你准备好进行灵性训练了吗？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很好。我会送你去训练场。到达那里后，请去对话负责训练的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
没关系，慢慢来。
愿上帝赐予你
克服恐惧的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You seem confident about the spiritual training. Shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
看来你对灵性训练很有信心。我们要开始吗？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很好。我会送你去训练场。到达那里后，请去对话负责训练的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
没关系，慢慢来。
愿上帝赐予你
克服恐惧的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You look tired and exhausted. However, you must endure even more suffering once you become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你看起来很疲惫。不过，一旦成为牧师，你必须忍受更多的苦难。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please endure these trials for the sake of your dream. Why don't you challenge the spiritual training again?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
请为了你的梦想忍受这些考验。为什么不挑战一下灵性训练呢？

scripts.text: I'll try again.
scripts.translation: 我再试一次

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. Please ask for help from Brother Peter.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很好。我会把你送到训练场。请向彼得兄弟寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
没关系，慢慢来。
愿上帝赐予你
克服恐惧的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I am glad that you've done well with the spiritual training. Congratulations. You are now qualified to be called a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
很高兴你在灵性训练中表现良好。恭喜你。你现在有资格被称为牧师了。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now, you must go and swear your devotion to God with Sister Cecilia. Don't be nervous...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
现在，你必须去和塞西莉亚修女一起宣誓效忠上帝。别紧张...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Just answer honestly, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
只需诚实回答，并倾听上帝在你心中轻声的话语。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then...
I will be here
waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
那么...
我会在这里
等你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hmm? You haven't made your oath yet...? Without the conviction of an oath to God, you may be tempted by evil at anytime.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
嗯？你还没有宣誓...？如果没有对上帝宣誓的决心，你可能会随时受到邪恶的诱惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You should go to sister Cecilia and promise your devotion to God. Return here with honor, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你应该去找塞西莉亚修女，承诺效忠上帝。带着荣耀回来，并倾听上帝在你心中轻声的话语。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You have remaining skills points. Please use these skill points to upgrade your skills, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你还有剩余的技能点。请使用这些技能点升级你的技能，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Congratulations, you have completed the trials required of all Priests. Let me promote you to the position of Priest right away.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
恭喜你，你完成了所有牧师必须经历的考验。让我立刻晋升你为牧师。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, grant your power to your servant standing before you.
Let him send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
上帝，请将你的力量赐予站在你面前的仆人。
让他将你的信息传遍世界的每一个角落。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, grant your power to your servant standing before you.
Let her send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
上帝，请将你的力量赐予站在你面前的仆人。
让她将你的信息传遍世界的每一个角落。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Make this servant of yours an instrument of your miraculous works...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
让这位仆人成为你奇迹工作的工具...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now you are born again as a Priest. I congratulate you, and hope you will greatly help other people for the rest of your life.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
如今你已重生为牧师。我祝贺你，并希望你余生能极大地帮助他人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
This book is for you. I hope it will aid you in spreading God's message on earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
这本书送给你。我希望它能帮助你向世人传播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
In commemoration of your job change, I am giving you a bible. This will lighten your way to the path of righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
为了纪念你的转职，我赠予你一本圣经。它将照亮你通往正义之路。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You've shown great effort, and have made admirable progress in your personal quest for holiness. Please lead your life as a sincere Priest...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保罗]
你付出了巨大的努力，在追求圣洁的道路上取得了令人钦佩的进步。请以虔诚之心作为牧师生活吧...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}.
Prontera parish welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你，{0}。
普隆德拉教区欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}.
Welcome to Prontera parish. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你，{0}。
欢迎来到普隆德拉教区。有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}. It brings my heart joy to see that you working hard to carry out the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你，{0}。看到你努力践行上帝的旨意，让我感到欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you, brother.
May I ask what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你，兄弟。
请问你为何而来？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you, sister.
May I ask what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你，姐妹。
请问你为何而来？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Ah, you've started your pilgrimage. Please do your best to accomplish this first trial.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
啊，你已经开始你的朝圣之旅了。请尽力完成这第一个考验。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you've met Father Rubalkabara. Now it's time for you to visit Sister Mathilda. She is near a town named Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
哦，你已经见过鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父了。现在该去拜访玛蒂尔达修女了。她在一个叫莫罗克的小镇附近。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now, the final Priest that you must meet is Father Yosuke. I've heard that he is training near a lake located Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
现在，你必须见面的最后一位牧师是阳介神父。我听说他在普隆德拉西北方向的一个湖泊附近修行。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome. You demonstrated great effort to accomplish your first trial. Now, speak to Bishop Paul so that you can begin your next trial on your path to Priesthood.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
欢迎回来。你付出了巨大的努力完成了第一个考验。现在，去和主教 保罗对话，开始你通往牧师之路的下一个考验吧。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you haven't finished the spiritual training yet?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
哦，你还没有完成灵性训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Yes, I understand that you've been through a really difficult situation. However, do not give up and succumb to temptation. You must be able to resist evil to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
是的，我理解你经历了一段非常艰难的处境。但是，不要放弃，也不要屈服于诱惑。你必须能够抵抗邪恶，才能成为牧师。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome! I'm so glad to see you've come back! Now, there is one last trial left for you to complete.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
欢迎回来！很高兴看到你回来了！现在，只剩下最后一个考验需要你去完成了。

scripts.text: [Sister Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亚修女]

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Congratulations.
You've completed all three trials required for the Priesthood. Bishop Paul is now waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
恭喜你。
你完成了成为牧师所需的全部三个考验。主教 保罗正在等你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you haven't chosen a job yet? Why don't you consider devoting your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
哦，你还没有选择职业吗？为什么不考虑将你的生命奉献给上帝呢？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
You can lead a fulfilling life as an Acolyte, helping out other people in need.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
作为服事，你可以过上充实的生活，帮助那些需要帮助的人。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you're interested, please ask the Priest in the other room. You won't ever regret the choice to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
如果你感兴趣，请去隔壁房间找牧师咨询。你绝不会后悔选择成为服事。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
When you reach Job level 40 as an Acolyte, you can be promoted to a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
当你的服事职业等级达到40级时，你可以晋升为牧师。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
But please...
Take your time, and decide what job will be the best for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
但是请...
慢慢来，决定哪个职业最适合你。

scripts.text: Tell me more about Priests.
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多关于牧师的事。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Messengers of God are usually known as Priests. After becoming an Acolyte, you can train with the goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
上帝的使者通常被称为牧师。成为服事后，你可以以成为牧师为目标进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Servants of God are prohibited to use weapons based on blades. For us, the meaning of battle with monsters is not in the killing, but in the enlightening of their souls.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
上帝的仆人禁止使用基于刀刃的武器。对我们来说，与魔物战斗的意义不在于杀戮，而在于启迪它们的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I see. Well, feel free to relax and make yourself at home. Nowhere on earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
我明白了。请放松，把这里当作你的家。世界上没有比普隆德拉圣堂更安全的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text: I wish to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成为牧师。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I see. You've devoted yourself to God. Many Acolytes wish to become Priests to continue on their personal journey towards holiness.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
我明白了。你已将自己奉献给上帝。许多服事都希望能成为牧师，继续他们通往圣洁的个人旅程。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Let me introduce myself. I am Cecilia Margarita, and I am in charge of part of the Priest job change process.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
让我自我介绍一下。我是塞西莉亚·玛格丽塔，负责牧师转职过程的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I've been supporting many people in becoming Priests ever since I joined the Prontera Parish. That is one of my main responsibilities.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
自从我加入普隆德拉教区以来，我一直支持许多人成为牧师。这是我的主要职责之一。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
In order to become a Priest, you must complete 3 trials. A pilgrimage, a session of spiritual training, and an oath of devotion to God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
为了成为牧师，你必须完成3项考验：朝圣、灵性训练，以及对上帝的奉献誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you wish to become a servant of God, please apply for the Priest job with Bishop Paul, and complete all 3 trials.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
如果你希望成为上帝的仆人，请向主教 保罗申请牧师职业，并完成所有3项考验。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you experience a problem during any of your trials, feel free to visit me. I will help you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
如果你在考验中遇到任何问题，请随时来找我。我会尽我所能帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Make yourself at home. I insist that you recover and take a rest in this Sanctuary. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
请随意。我坚持让你在这个圣堂里恢复和休息。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
The first Priest you must meet is Father Rubalkabara. He is in the ruins Northeast of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你必须见的第一位牧师是鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父。他在普隆德拉东北方的废墟中。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Travel one field North from Prontera, and then three fields East, and you will arrive at the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
从普隆德拉向北走一个地图，然后向东走三个地图，你就会到达废墟。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Of course, you can also head 1 field East from Prontera, then go 1 field north, and then go 2 fields East...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
当然，你也可以从普隆德拉向东走一个地图，然后向北走一个地图，再向东走两个地图...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Father Rubalkabara will be at the entrance of the Prontera Ruins. Be careful. That place is a habitat for aggressive Chocos.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父会在普隆德拉废墟的入口处。请小心，那里是攻击性强的巧克猴的栖息地。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
After meeting Father Rubalkabara, please visit Sister Mathilda and Father Yosuke. You can check your quest progress with me if you have any questions later.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
见到鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父后，请去拜访玛蒂尔达修女和阳介神父。如果你之后有任何问题，可以来找我查看任务进度。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Well then, have a good journey. Please don't give up to short lived tribulations, and I hope that you accomplish your goals.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
那么，祝你旅途愉快。请不要因短暂的磨难而放弃，希望你能达成自己的目标。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
She has been training her religious discipline somewhere in a field North of Morocc. If you look around that field, you will be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
她正在摩洛克北边的某个地图进行宗教修行。如果你在那张地图四处看看，就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Of course, sometimes I want to devote myself to training like those other Priests, but I have my duty to assist those Acolytes applying for the Priest job.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
当然，有时我也想像其他牧师那样专心修行，但我有责任协助那些申请成为牧师的服事。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
But I believe this is God's will, and that this is the work he has intended me to do as his servant. Have a safe journey, and come back safely.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
但我相信这是上帝的旨意，是他希望我作为他的仆人去做的工作。祝你旅途平安，并安全归来。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
From Prontera, travel one field North, and then two fields towards the West. You may also travel two fields West first, and then travel one field to the North.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
从普隆德拉向北走一个地图，然后向西走两个地图。你也可以先向西走两个地图，再向北走一个地图。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Although there are still two trials awaiting you, I have faith that you will be able to accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
虽然还有两项考验等着你，但我相信你能达成成为牧师的目标...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
The spiritual training is much more difficult than the pilgrimage, but I believe in you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}弟兄...
精神修行比朝圣更艰难，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
The spiritual training is much more difficult than the pilgrimage, but I believe in you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}姐妹...
精神修行比朝圣更艰难，但我相信你能做到。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I hope that you find someone who has already become a Priest to help during the spiritual training. Good luck, and have faith.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
我希望你能找到一位已经成为牧师的人，在精神修行期间帮助你。祝你好运，保持信心。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I cannot let you know the specific details, but as long as you believe in yourself and have faith in all that is good, you will succeed.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
我不能告诉你具体的细节，但只要你相信自己，并对一切美好事物保持信心，你就会成功。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Please speak to Father Peter in the test hall for more details. He is a close friend of Bishop Paul and may give you some useful tips for the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
请去试炼大厅找彼得神父了解更多细节。他是保罗主教的密友，可能会给你一些关于精神修行的有用建议。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you know somebody who has already become a Priest, ask them to help you during your spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
如果你认识已经成为牧师的人，请让他们在你的精神修行期间帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God give you guidance and protection. When you complete your training, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿上帝指引并保护你。完成修行后，请回到我这里。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome back.
I hope that you've reflected on what you've said last time, and that you now have the attitude to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
欢迎回来。
我希望你反思了上次说的话，并且现在具备了成为牧师的态度。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
We will now begin your formal oath for the Priesthood. Make yourself comfortable, and just answer with your heart.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}弟兄...
我们现在开始你的正式牧师宣誓。请放松，用心回答即可。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
We will now begin your formal oath for the Priesthood. Make yourself comfortable, and just answer with your heart.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}姐妹...
我们现在开始你的正式牧师宣誓。请放松，用心回答即可。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0},
Are you willing
to give your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}弟兄，
你愿意将生命献给上帝吗？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0},
Are you willing
to give your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}姐妹，
你愿意将生命献给上帝吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Aw...? How could you give me that kind of answer? I assume you're not ready to be a Priest yet...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
哎呀...？你怎么能给出这样的回答呢？看来你还没有准备好成为一名牧师...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
You should reflect a little more on the teachings of holiness and come back later. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is weak.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你应该多反思一下神圣的教诲，稍后再来。如果你的精神不够坚定，是无法成为牧师的。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you take advantage of the holy abilities given by God for selfish, destructive or greedy ends?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你会利用上帝赐予的神圣力量，出于自私、破坏或贪婪的目的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Aw...? God won't grant you the power of holiness if your goals aren't just and pure. Meditate on your motivations for a while, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
哎呀...？如果你的目标不公正且纯洁，上帝不会赐予你神圣的力量。请冥想一下你的动机，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Think about the qualities that make Priests people of respect. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is not in accordance with God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
想想看，是什么品质让牧师受到人们的尊敬。如果你的精神不符合上帝的旨意，你就无法成为牧师。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you help aid others, even complete strangers, in battles by easing their suffering?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你愿意在战斗中帮助他人，甚至是完全的陌生人，减轻他们的痛苦吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No, no. You've got the wrong idea. God authorizes us to use his power to support his children. You must help people in danger: it is your obligation.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
不，不。你的想法错了。上帝授权我们使用他的力量来支持他的子民。你必须帮助处于危险中的人：这是你的义务。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Go and observe the adventurers that are fighting for peace in this world. They will teach you what you must do in order to help them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
去观察一下那些为了世界和平而战斗的冒险者吧。他们会教会你，为了帮助他们，你必须做什么。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the sake of others?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你愿意为了他人的利益而牺牲自己吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
How can you say no...? That's one of the basic principles of Priesthood. You must value the welfare of others over your own safety.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你怎么能说“不”呢...？这是牧师的基本准则之一。你必须将他人的福祉置于自己的安全之上。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Go and think about the value of suffering and the meaning of sacrifice. When you think you understand more about helping those in need, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
去想想痛苦的价值和牺牲的意义。当你觉得自己更懂得如何帮助有需要的人时，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you repeatly say the same phrase in public in order to send God's message to his children?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你会在公共场合反复说同样的话，以便将上帝的信息传达给他的子民吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No no no... You've got it wrong. Even though your purpose is to spread God's message, no one will eagerly accept what you say when you spam text.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
不不不...你搞错了。虽然你的目的是传播上帝的信息，但如果你像刷屏一样说话，没人会乐意接受你说的话。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Remember...
You must be a moral person, and display maturity and respect to other players. This kind of attitude applies for all classes,
I believe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
记住...
你必须是一个有道德的人，并对其他玩家表现出成熟和尊重。我相信这种态度适用于所有职业。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you lure many monsters to help your party members level up?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你会引诱大量魔物来帮助你的队伍成员升级吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No, you won't. Luring many monsters does more harm than good. There is no exception. That behavior is totally unacceptable.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
不，你不会。引诱大量魔物弊大于利。没有任何例外。这种行为是完全不可接受的。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Even if it looks like you are aiding your party members, such action results in bad karma. Please reflect on that for a while.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
即使看起来你是在帮助你的队伍成员，这种行为也会导致恶果。请对此反思一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you follow God, no matter what it takes, even if he demands you to kill yourself?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
无论付出什么代价，你都会追随上帝，即使他要求你自杀吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
With that spirit, you can't be a Priest. If it is God's will to sacrifice yourself for a good purpose, you must carry out God's will as his servant.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
怀着这种精神，你无法成为牧师。如果上帝旨意要求你为了好的目的而牺牲自己，你必须作为他的仆人执行上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Besides, God has also given Priests the resurrection power. Think about the meaning of life and death again, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
此外，上帝也赋予了牧师复活的力量。请重新思考生与死的意义，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
You have demonstrated your devotion to God. Will you swear to adhere to his teachings for the rest of your days?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}兄弟...
你已展现出对上帝的虔诚。你愿意发誓，余生都遵循他的教诲吗？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
You have demonstrated your devotion to God. Will you swear to adhere to his teachings for the rest of your days?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
{0}姐妹...
你已展现出对上帝的虔诚。你愿意发誓，余生都遵循他的教诲吗？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now, you have completed your oath of Priesthood and accomplished all three trials required to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
现在，你已完成牧师的誓言，并通过了成为牧师所需的三项考验。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now go to Bishop Paul. And remember, we are all brothers and sisters in the eyes of God. Peace be with you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
现在，去见主教保罗吧。记住，在上帝的眼中，我们皆为兄弟姐妹。愿平安与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
......

[Sister Cecilia]
You've come so far...
Why would you want
to throw this all away...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
你已经走了这么远...
为什么要放弃这一切呢...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Peace be with you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚修女]
愿平安与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Brother {0}!
So good to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
欢迎！
{0}兄弟！
很高兴再次见到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Sister {0}!
So good to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
欢迎！
{0}姐妹！
很高兴再次见到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome~!
I congratulate you
for passing the first trail.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
欢迎~！
恭喜你通过了第一项考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you ready this time?
Complete this trial quickly,
and become a Priest!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
这次准备好了吗？
快点完成这项考验，
成为牧师吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go back!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你是来帮服事朋友进行灵性训练的吗？那太好了~我觉得你会做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Remember, no matter how much you want to help this Acolyte, this is not your quest.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
记住，无论多想帮这位服事，这都不是你的任务。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
You may assist and lighten your friend's burden, but you take upon this task for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你可以协助并减轻朋友的负担，但这项任务是你自己承担的。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
So...
Are you gonna help him right now?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
那么...
你现在要去帮他吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go for it! As your Acolyte enters, the test will begin. Now, I will send you to the testing area.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
去吧！当你的服事进入时，测试就会开始。现在，我将把你传送到测试区域。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm...?
What for?
Well, so long as you arrive in time to help your friend, it will be okay.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯...？
为什么？
好吧，只要你能及时赶到帮助朋友，就没问题。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh...?
Then please,
go ahead. God bless
you, and take care!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哦...？
那么请便吧。上帝保佑你，保重！

scripts.text:
Welcome~!
I congratulate you
for passing the first trail.
scripts.translation:
欢迎~！
恭喜你通过了
第一道试炼。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
My name is
Peter S. Alberto.
How is my buddy Paul?
Is he doing alright
these days?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我的名字是
彼得·S·阿尔贝托。
我的伙伴保罗最近怎么样？
他最近还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh, I keep forgetting that he was promoted to Bishop. I think I'm supposed to call him Bishop Paul, or 'His Excellency.' Haha~
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哎呀，我总是忘记他已经晋升为主教了。我想我应该叫他保罗主教，或者“阁下”。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Anyway, let me give you a brief explanation of the spiritual training. Are you familiar with what the spiritual training is for Priests?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
总之，让我简单解释一下灵性训练。你知道牧师进行灵性训练的目的是什么吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Haha, I like you! But it never hurts to have too much information. The more well informed you are, the more easily you'll pass the test!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哈哈，我喜欢你！但多了解一些信息总没坏处。了解得越多，你就越容易通过测试！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh, no need to be sorry. I'm here to give you the information you need anyway. So, don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哦，不用道歉。我本来就是要给你提供你需要的信息。所以，别担心。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
In spiritual training, you will be defeating evil creatures. Creatures of the Undead and Demons are all evil. In choosing to serve darkness, they are our enemies!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
在灵性训练中，你将消灭邪恶的生物。不死族和恶魔都是邪恶的。既然它们选择了侍奉黑暗，它们就是我们的敌人！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
There are too many evil creatures that roam this world against the will of God. Innocents suffer as a result of their malignance.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
这个世界上有太多违背上帝旨意的邪恶生物在游荡。无辜的人们因此遭受苦难。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
We, as Priests, are obligated to exterminate all those creatures, thus spreading love and peace.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我们作为牧师，有义务消灭所有这些生物，从而传播爱与和平。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
This training will test your ability to eliminate evil. Since this trial is pretty difficult to be accomplished by yourself,
I recommend getting help from a Priest if you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
这次训练将考验你消灭邪恶的能力。由于这项试炼很难独自完成，
如果可能的话，我建议你寻求牧师的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you are close to a Priest, you'd better ask him to assist you during this trial. Now, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你和某位牧师关系不错，最好请他在试炼中协助你。那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了

scripts.text: Please hold on.
scripts.translation: 请稍等。

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now, let the spiritual training begin. It's simple. Just kill them all. Show no mercy to the creatures of darkness!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
现在，灵性训练开始。很简单。把它们全部杀掉。对黑暗的生物不要心慈手软！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now...
Go for it!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
现在...
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm? What is it you need?
Well, no problem. You can
afford to take your time.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯？你需要什么？
嗯，没问题。你可以
慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
What...?
You wanna go back??
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
什么...？
你想回去？？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事务要处理。等你方便的时候再回来吧。

scripts.text:
Are you ready this time?
Complete this trial quickly,
and become a Priest!
scripts.translation:
这次准备好了吗？
尽快完成这项试炼，
成为牧师吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you ready then?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了

scripts.text: Please hold on.
scripts.translation: 请稍等。

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now, let the spiritual training begin. For the glory of God, for peace on earth, and goodwill towards all men...
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
现在，精神训练开始。
为了上帝的荣耀，为了世间的和平，为了对所有人的善意...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go...
Kill those
misbegotten creatures!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
去吧...
消灭那些
不祥的生物！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm? What is it you need?
Well, no problem. You can
afford to take your time.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯？你需要什么？
嗯，没问题。你可以
慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
What...?
You wanna go back??
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
什么...？
你想回去？？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事务要处理。等你方便的时候再回来吧。

scripts.text: Go back!
scripts.translation: 回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Brother {0}!
So good to see you!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
欢迎！
{0}兄弟！
见到你真好！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Sister {0}!
So good to see you!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
欢迎！
{0}姐妹！
见到你真好！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Please hold on for a while. Another acolyte is in the training ground right now.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
请稍等片刻。现在有一位服事正在训练场。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Peace...
Be with you.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
愿平安...
与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你是来帮服事朋友进行灵性训练的吗？那太好了~我觉得你会做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Well, another Acolyte is in the training ground right now. You'll need to wait a little bit longer...
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯，现在有一位服事正在训练场。你需要再等一会儿...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Please come back a little later. If this acolyte's done with the training, I will send you to the training area.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
请稍后再来。如果这位服事完成了训练，我会送你去训练区。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你想参加测试，请稍等片刻，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你想参加测试，请稍等片刻，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
When the Priest applicant enters, 5 minutes will be given to complete this trial. Proceed slowly and help your Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
当牧师候选人进入时，将有5分钟的时间来完成这项试炼。请慢慢前进，并帮助你的服事。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Enter through the warp at the end of the hall, where you will be lead to the next test hall.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
通过大厅尽头的传送门，你将前往下一个测试大厅。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Remember...
This trial must be
completed within
5 minutes. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
记住...
这项试炼必须
在5分钟内完成。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I will give you exactly 5 minutes! You must proceed slowly and eliminate the Zombies.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我将给你整整5分钟！请慢慢前进并消灭腐尸。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Slay all the zombies and go through the warp at the end of the hall. Make sure that you kill them all.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
消灭所有的腐尸，并通过大厅尽头的传送门。确保你杀光了它们。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Whaaaaat...?
What are you
doing back here?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哇...？
你怎么又
回到这里了？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well, look who's the ^660000BMOC^000000 now. That's '^660000B^000000ig ^660000M^000000an ^660000O^000000n ^660000C^000000ampus,' if you didn't know. By the way, I was being sarcastic. You know, if you didn't notice.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哟，看看现在谁是^660000BMOC^000000了。如果你不知道的话，那是'^660000B^000000ig ^660000M^000000an ^660000O^000000n ^660000C^000000ampus'的缩写。顺便说一句，我在讽刺你。如果你没注意到的话。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Are you really
happy being a Priest?
There's no possible way.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你真的
很高兴成为牧师吗？
这绝对不可能。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Alright, alright, for old time's sake, I'll let you pass me. But only this once. But I better not catch you again! This is evil turf, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
好吧好吧，看在老交情的份上，这次让你过去。但只有这一次。但我下次再抓到你就没这么客气了！这是邪恶的地盘，你听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Why...
Hello little Aco.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
为什么...
你好啊，小牧师。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
You must be here training hard to be a Priest. Funny, I know a lot of God's servants, actually. They tell me that it's really tough serving that God guy all the time. So... So ^666666tiring^000000 and ^666666unrewarding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你一定是来这里刻苦训练，想成为牧师的吧。真有趣，我其实认识很多神的仆人。他们告诉我，整天侍奉那位神大人真的很辛苦。所以...所以^666666很累^000000，而且^666666毫无回报^000000。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I mean, people are always crying to Priests for help no matter where they are. And Priests never get anything in return...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我的意思是，无论在哪里，人们总是哭着向牧师求助。而牧师却得不到任何回报...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
It's tragic really, how unappreciated Priests are.
It's so clear that any job is better. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
牧师如此不被重视，真是悲剧。
很明显，任何职业都比这好。随便什么都行...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Wouldn't life be so much easier if you weren't a Priest? And it'd be so easy. All you'd have to do is quit right now...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
如果你不是牧师，生活会不会轻松很多？而且这很容易。你只需要现在辞职就行了...

scripts.text: You're right, I quit!
scripts.translation: 你说得对，我辞职！

scripts.text: Out of my sight, demon!
scripts.translation: 滚远点，恶魔！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
^660000YES~!^000000 I mean...
Good for you!

[Deviruchi]
Oh...?
Look at the ^660000time^000000.
You better get going.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哦...？
看看^660000时间^000000。
你最好赶紧走了。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
BWAHAHAHAHAHAH!
GET THE JOKE!?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哇哈哈哈！
懂这个笑话吗？！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Out of your sight?
I guess I'm not the
cutest thing you've
ever seen, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
滚远点？
看来我不是你见过的
最可爱的家伙，
是吧？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
But how about this...? Now, isn't this an attractive sight? A nice, shiny new card. Mint condition. Not too many people have this you know. But I happen to have soooo many, my pockets hurt.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
不过这个怎么样...？现在，这难道不是一道迷人的风景吗？一张崭新闪亮的卡片。全新未拆封。知道的人不多哦。但我碰巧有好多好多，多到口袋都疼了。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Isn't it everyone's dream to have one of these? Think about it, being a Priest can only bring you suffering...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
拥有这样一张卡片难道不是每个人的梦想吗？想想看，当牧师只会给你带来痛苦...

scripts.text: You're right, I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 你说得对，我要了！

scripts.text: Silence!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Good choice!
This card can
can be yours...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
好选择！
这张卡片
可以归你所有...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Theoretically!
BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Go and earn it yourself!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
理论上！
哇哈哈哈哈哈哈！
自己去赚吧！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Did...
Did you just tell
me to shut up?
Oh my God...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你...
你刚才让我
闭嘴了？
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Sorry...
Oh ^660000your^000000 God.
Fine, get going.
But you'll regret
your decision later!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
抱歉...
哦，^660000你的^000000神。
好吧，走吧。
但你之后会后悔
这个决定的！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
What are you doing here? You've already made your choice, there's no going back... Priest.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
你在这里做什么？你已经做出了选择，没有回头路了...牧师。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Besides, this is none of your business. Whether or not this Acolyte becomes a Priest isn't up to you. Now get out of here, before I get violent.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
而且，这不关你的事。
这个服事能不能成为牧师，
不是你能决定的。
现在滚出去，
不然我就动手了。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Hold on there, Acolyte.
I'm not like Deviruchi,
so I won't mince
words with you.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
站住，服事。
我不像小恶魔那样，
不会跟你拐弯抹角。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now, why would you want to become a Priest? It's such a worthless, thankless job. If you want, I'll give you the chance to become a Novice. Then you can become something much better!
scripts.translation:
[分身]
那么，你为什么想成为牧师？
那是一份毫无价值、吃力不讨好的工作。
如果你愿意，我可以给你机会
转职为初心者。
那样你就能成为更厉害的角色！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Of course, I'll let you redistribute your stat points by your base level. Now, isn't that a sweet deal...?
scripts.translation:
[分身]
当然，我会根据你的基础等级
让你重新分配属性点。
怎么样，这交易很划算吧...？

scripts.text: Deal, Deal!
scripts.translation: 成交，成交！

scripts.text: No deal... Doppelganger.
scripts.translation: 不成交...分身。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Good choice~
I shall return your
job to a Novice
as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
好选择~
如你所愿，
我会把你的职业
转回初心者。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now go!!
Never step into
the light again!
scripts.translation:
[分身]
现在滚！！
永远不要再踏入
光明之中！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
I don't think you understood what I just offered. Think about it again. I mean, this is your one and only chance to undo your life mistakes. I mean, becoming an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[分身]
我想你没听懂我刚才的提议。
再想想吧。我是说，
这是你唯一一次
弥补人生错误的机会。
我是说，成为服事？

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Just don't become a Priest. I won't ask you more than once. Then you can choose a better job... perhaps a Swordman like me.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
只要别成为牧师就行。
我只问一次。
那样你就可以选择更好的职业...
比如像我一样的剑士。

scripts.text: I don't want to be a Priest!
scripts.translation: 我不想当牧师！

scripts.text: I'll never listen to you!
scripts.translation: 我绝不会听你的！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Excellent choice. Now, never return to this place. I shall return your job to Novice as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
极好的选择。现在，
永远不要再回到这里。
如你所愿，
我会把你的职业转回初心者。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now go!!
Never step into
the light again!
scripts.translation:
[分身]
现在滚！！
永远不要再踏入
光明之中！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Hmpf. I admire
your determination.
Okay, you can pass.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
哼。我佩服你的提升斗志。
好吧，你可以过去了。
暂时。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
But if by chance we meet again,
I assure you... You won't be happy at all to see me.
scripts.translation:
[分身]
但万一我们再次相遇，
我向你保证...你绝对不会
高兴见到我的。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033All is doom, darkness and despair! Those who love you will betray you, and all that will be left is grieving and fury!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033一切皆是厄运、黑暗与绝望！爱你的人将背叛你，剩下的只有悲伤与爆气！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033To choose to become a servant of God is to choose eternal pain!
I shall personally see to that, mortal.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033选择成为神的仆从，就是选择永恒的痛苦！
我会亲自确保这一点，凡人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Halt, human.
Who has granted
you passage?^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033站住，人类。
谁允许
你通过的？^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033You still wish to become a Priest?! Fool! Then, I shall not let you pass. Go back. Otherwise, you will not survive.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330030你仍然想成为牧师？！愚蠢！那么，我不会让你通过。回去。否则，你活不下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033It would be so easy for me to snap your fragile body in twain and grind your bones to dust.
Now, go back mortal!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033对我来说，折断你脆弱的身体，将你的骨头碾成粉末，是轻而易举的事。
现在，回去吧，凡人！^000000

scripts.text: I'm so sorry. Spare me!
scripts.translation: 对不起，饶了我吧！

scripts.text: God will protect me.
scripts.translation: 神会保护我的。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Don't ever come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033永远不要再回来了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033It is no use to feign strength and courage. You are completely helpless before me. Your skills are laughable, and your weapons are but mere toys compared to my power.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033装出坚强和勇敢的样子是没用的。在我面前，你完全无助。你的技能可笑至极，你的武器与我的力量相比，不过是玩具罢了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033With just a wave of my hand, you will cease to exist. And no one will remember you. Tremble before the might of my infinite magic!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033只需我挥挥手，你就会消失无踪。没有人会记得你。在我无限的魔力面前颤抖吧！^000000

scripts.text: I beg you, don't...!
scripts.translation: 求求你，不要...！

scripts.text: Begone, vile fiend!
scripts.translation: 滚开，邪恶的恶魔！

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Don't ever come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033永远不要再回来了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Why...
Why don't you fear me?!
For a frail mortal, you
are quite annoying.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033为什么...你竟然不怕我？！作为一个脆弱的人类，你真是相当讨厌。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033When next we meet, I will shall escort you to a realm of suffering where you shall spend years immersed in excruciating pain.
Mark my words...^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033下次见面时，我会送你前往一个充满苦难的领域，让你在那里忍受数年难以忍受的痛苦。记住我的话...^000000

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I hate
Priests...
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我讨厌牧师...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I don't have any business with you, servant of God. Just pass through.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我和你没有关系，神的仆从。请通过吧。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
...{0}.

[Baphomet]
Yes, human,
I know who you are.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
是的，人类，我知道你是谁。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I also know that Deviruchi, Doppelganger and the Dark Lord have all failed to convince you to turn away from the Priesthood.
Now, I stand before
you to offer a deal.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我也知道，小恶魔、分身和暗黑之王都未能说服你放弃牧师之路。现在，我站在你面前，向你提出一个交易。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I can grant you any treasure you desire and infinite power at your fingertips. Powerful weapons that humans have never before seen...
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我可以赐予你任何你想要的宝物，以及指尖掌控的无限力量。人类从未见过的强大武器...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Mountains of zeny that you cannot possibly hope to spend in a lifetime. Though, who's to say that your lifespan should be limited? Fame, power, immortality: It can all be yours.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
堆积如山的Zeny，你一生都花不完。不过，谁又能说你的寿命是有限的呢？名声、力量、永生：这些都可以属于你。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I will be yours to summon at anytime. All other humans will dread making you their enemy. You will become the most powerful person in all of history!
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我将随时听候你的召唤。所有其他人类都会畏惧与你为敌。你将变得有史以来最强大！

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Cease this foolishness of pursuing the Priesthood. Make a contract with me. The entire world is yours for the taking.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
停止这种追求牧师身份的愚蠢行为吧。与我签订契约。整个世界都将是你的囊中之物。

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交。

scripts.text: No, Baphomet. You lose.
scripts.translation: 不，巴风特。你输了。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Then we shall form a contract. You won't ever regret this moment...
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
那么，我们就签订契约吧。你绝不会后悔这一刻的...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Follow me.
We will make the
contract in my
sanctum of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
跟我来。
我们将在我的黑暗圣所中签订契约。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Foolish human...
You have made your choice. I will leave you alone for now, then. However, your training won't be as easy as you think.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
愚蠢的人类...
你做出了你的选择。那么，我现在就放过你。不过，你的修行可不会像你想象的那么轻松。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I shall be preparing my troops for you. The day will come when I shall enjoy watching you writhe in agony as my fiends slowly devour you.
scripts.translation:
[巴风特]
我会为你准备好我的军队。总有一天，我会享受看着你在痛苦中挣扎，任由我的恶魔慢慢吞噬你的乐趣。

scripts.text: Ah yes, so you're the young Acolyte who wishes to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 啊，原来你就是那位想要成为牧师的年轻服事啊。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've received the message from Bishop Paul. Since you made the pilgrimage, I hope you accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我收到了主教 保罗的信。既然你完成了朝圣，我希望你能实现成为牧师的目标。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Also, if you have a chance, please visit this abbey again. It's a sacred place for our Church.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
另外，如果有机会，请再次造访这座修道院。它是我们教会的圣地。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well then, please head to your next destination for your pilgrimage. Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
那么，请前往你朝圣的下一站吧。旅途平安。

scripts.text: Please be hurry to the next destination for your pilgrimage. I hope you become a Priest soon.
scripts.translation: 请赶快前往朝圣的下一站吧。希望你能早日成为牧师。

scripts.text: May I ask why you have returned? Please go back and continue your religious practice.
scripts.translation: 请问你为何折返？请回去继续你的修行吧。

scripts.text: I have no idea what brought you here, but please excuse me.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你为何会来这里，请原谅我的怠慢。

scripts.text:
Hmm...
It seems you're
training to become
a Priest.
scripts.translation:
嗯...
看来你正在
接受成为
牧师的训练。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
However, at this point in your pilgrimage, I am not the person that you should be visiting.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
不过，在你朝圣的这个阶段，我不应该是你要拜访的人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should ask Bishop Paul or Sister Cecilia once again. Well, may God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
也许你应该再问问主教 保罗或塞西莉亚修女。那么，愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
Ah, are you
a Priest trainee...?
Welcome!
scripts.translation:
啊，你是
牧师的学员吗...
欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
We Priests are obliged to spread the message of God to
the peoples of the Earth.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我们牧师有义务将上帝的旨意传播给大地上的人民。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
After you become a Priest, your travels may take you to the Morocc Pyramids. I hope that you may release the Undead there from the evil to which they are bound.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
在你成为牧师后，你的旅程可能会带你前往摩洛哥金字塔。我希望你能释放那里被邪恶束缚的不死者。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Well then...
I shall pray to
God for safety
on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
那么...
我会向上帝祈祷，保佑你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
Please leave soon, and
continue your training.
scripts.translation:
请快点离开，
继续你的训练吧。

scripts.text: May I ask you the reason you came back? Please continue your training.
scripts.translation: 请问你回来的原因是什么？请继续你的修行。

scripts.text:
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation: 愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
Hmm...
A Priest trainee, eh?
scripts.translation:
嗯...
一个牧师学员，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Well, you got the wrong person. If you're supposed to meet up with me at all, it'd be later.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你找错人了。如果你要和我碰面，应该是在更晚的时候。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
But that's your own fault.
Now, go back to Church, kid.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
但那是你自己的错。
现在，回教堂去，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
But that's your own fault. Go back to Church.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
但那是你自己的错。回教堂去。

scripts.text:
Hmm.
A Priest
trainee, eh? 
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
嗯。
一个牧师学员，是吗？
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
I won't say
anything more.
Just devote your
life to God.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
我不会再说更多了。
只需将你的生命奉献给上帝。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to church.
Hereby, the first of
your trials is now
completed.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
现在回教堂去。
至此，你的第一项试炼
已经完成。

scripts.text:
I told you to go back to church.
Or do you want to live with me here for the rest of your life...?
scripts.translation:
我让你回教堂去。
难道你想在这里和我过一辈子...？

scripts.text: Just go be a Priest. This isn't a playground for kids.
scripts.translation: 去当你的牧师吧。这里不是小孩的游乐场。

scripts.text: ...Acolyte, you don't have any business with me here.
scripts.translation: ...服事，你和我在这里没有什么关系。
